hold_ms.description: The least time a zoom is held after its last click, 500 to 10000 ms. Default 1200.

item_id.description: A clip of a screen recording.

lead_ms.description: The full zoom is reached this long before the first click, 0 to 3000 ms. Default 400.

level.description: How far the view zooms in, 1.1 to 3. Default 1.6.

max_zooms.description: The most zooms made, the first in time, 1 to 24. Default 24.

merge_ms.description: Clicks closer than this, in one window, make one zoom, 0 to 10000 ms. Default 2500.

ramp_ms.description: The length of the ease in and of the ease out, 200 to 3000 ms. Default 700.
